candidate_program.name: mean_conflict_density
candidate_program.rationale: Adjusts reward per blocked contact by a bounded comparison with mean conflicting reward, keeping count and weight scales separate. Uses only base inputs and remains blind to remote edge rearrangements.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.15 * (weight - conflict_weight / max(1, degree)) / (1 + weight + conflict_weight / max(1, degree)))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
